title: Approval Node Entity
description: JSON Schema for Approval node entity (workflows/{workflow_id}/approvals/{id}.json). Human-in-the-loop gate that pauses event flow pending a decision. Bounds match graph-patch-apply validateApprovalNodePayload. additionalProperties stays open because ApprovalNodeEntity ([key: string]: unknown) and graph patch node_config carry runtime-specific keys; known fields are typed and required fields are enforced.

approval_node_id.description: Unique identifier for the approval node

workflow_id.description: Workflow this approval node belongs to

approval_channel.description: Channel where approval requests are sent (1-256 characters)

timeout_hours.description: Hours before the approval request times out (1-168)

upstream_entity_id.description: Upstream node in the workflow graph

upstream_entity_type.description: Entity type of the upstream node

upstream_label.description: Labelled edge from the upstream node (approval branches)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the node was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the node was last updated

output_queue_display_name.description: Observe label for this approval node's approved queue. Deploy writes it onto the existing queue id and leaves bindings, checkpoints, and bot pause unchanged. Unset: the generated label stays the fallback and is not overwritten.

error_queue_display_name.description: Observe label for this approval node's rejected queue. Deploy writes it onto the existing queue id and leaves bindings, checkpoints, and bot pause unchanged. Unset: the generated label stays the fallback and is not overwritten.
